# Indiatimes
> Indiatimes is a lifestyle-focused digital publication covering health, wellness, fashion, food, travel, relationships, and trending culture.

The site publishes feature stories, explainers, trend pieces, and advice-driven articles aimed at helping readers stay current on lifestyle topics and everyday wellness.

## Main
- [Home](https://www.indiatimes.com/): Main entry point for Indiatimes lifestyle stories, trending features, and editorial highlights.
- [Latest Stories](https://www.indiatimes.com/latest/): Recently published articles across lifestyle, wellness, fashion, and culture topics.
- [Trending](https://www.indiatimes.com/trending/): Popular and fast-rising stories capturing current internet and lifestyle trends.

## Lifestyle
- [Lifestyle](https://www.indiatimes.com/lifestyle/): Broad lifestyle coverage including habits, culture, advice, and everyday living topics.
- [Health](https://www.indiatimes.com/health/): Articles on health news, fitness, mental wellbeing, and practical wellness guidance.
- [Wellness](https://www.indiatimes.com/wellness/): Wellness-focused stories covering self-care, routines, and healthy living ideas.
- [Fashion](https://www.indiatimes.com/fashion/): Fashion trends, style advice, celebrity looks, and wardrobe inspiration.
- [Beauty](https://www.indiatimes.com/beauty/): Beauty tips, skincare ideas, grooming trends, and product-focused features.

## Food & Drink
- [Food](https://www.indiatimes.com/food/): Food trends, recipes, dining features, and ingredient-driven lifestyle stories.
- [Drinks](https://www.indiatimes.com/drinks/): Beverage trends, drink ideas, and stories around popular refreshments.
- [Recipes](https://www.indiatimes.com/recipes/): Recipe-oriented content for home cooking and food experimentation.
- [Nutrition](https://www.indiatimes.com/nutrition/): Nutrition explainers and diet-related wellness articles for everyday readers.

## Travel & Leisure
- [Travel](https://www.indiatimes.com/travel/): Travel inspiration, destination ideas, and practical trip-planning features.
- [Places](https://www.indiatimes.com/places/): Stories highlighting destinations, attractions, and location-based recommendations.
- [Weekend Getaways](https://www.indiatimes.com/weekend-getaways/): Short-trip inspiration and nearby escape ideas for leisure travelers.

## Relationships & Society
- [Relationships](https://www.indiatimes.com/relationships/): Advice, commentary, and features on dating, friendship, and modern relationships.
- [Sex & Relationships](https://www.indiatimes.com/sex-relationships/): Intimacy, dating culture, and relationship-focused lifestyle coverage.
- [Society](https://www.indiatimes.com/society/): Social trends, cultural commentary, and people-centered feature stories.

## Entertainment & Culture
- [Entertainment](https://www.indiatimes.com/entertainment/): Coverage of celebrities, streaming, pop culture, and entertainment trends.
- [Movies](https://www.indiatimes.com/movies/): Film-related features, reactions, and movie trend coverage.
- [TV](https://www.indiatimes.com/tv/): Television and streaming stories, recaps, and viewer-focused features.
- [Celebrities](https://www.indiatimes.com/celebrities/): Celebrity news, style moments, and personality-driven culture stories.

## Special Features
- [Explainers](https://www.indiatimes.com/explainers/): Context-driven articles breaking down trends, events, and lifestyle topics.
- [Opinion](https://www.indiatimes.com/opinion/): Editorial commentary and perspective pieces on culture and society.
- [Photos](https://www.indiatimes.com/photos/): Visual galleries and image-led storytelling across lifestyle and entertainment.
- [Videos](https://www.indiatimes.com/videos/): Video content featuring stories, trends, and short-form editorial coverage.

## Utility
- [About](https://www.indiatimes.com/about): Overview of the publication, editorial identity, and brand context.
- [Contact Us](https://www.indiatimes.com/contactus): Contact information and communication channels for the publication.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.indiatimes.com/privacypolicy): Privacy practices, data handling details, and user information policy.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.indiatimes.com/termsandconditions): Terms governing access to and use of the website.
- [Sitemap](https://www.indiatimes.com/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for discovering site structure and published content URLs.
